title: "Why Keeping Jesus to Yourself is Selfish" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Why Keeping Jesus to Yourself is Selfish" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 Imagine this:
You discover the cure for cancer—a single pill that can save anyone’s life instantly.

Would you:
✅ Share it with the world, saving millions?
❌ Keep it to yourself and let people die?
🚨 If you chose to share it, then why are you keeping Jesus a secret?
Sin is the deadliest disease in the world, and Jesus is the only cure!
📖 “Let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.” (Matthew 5:16)
💡 If you truly love people, you will share Jesus with them.

🔥 The Greatest Tragedy: Knowing Jesus But Staying Silent
Many Christians say:

“I don’t want to offend anyone.”
“It’s not my place to judge.”
“What if they reject me?”
But the truth is: keeping Jesus to yourself is one of the most selfish things you can do.
📖 “For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-discipline.” (2 Timothy 1:7)
💡 Fear is from the enemy—boldness is from God!

🔥 Why Are So Many Christians Silent?
1️⃣ Fear of Rejection
Many people worry, “What if they laugh at me? What if they don’t listen?”
But Jesus said:
📖 “If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated Me first.” (John 15:18)
💡 People’s opinions don’t matter—eternity does!

2️⃣ Afraid of Not Knowing Enough
Some think, “I don’t know the Bible well enough to share.”
But you don’t need a theology degree—just share your testimony!
📖 “We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom.” (Colossians 1:28)
💡 Your story is powerful—no one can argue with your testimony!

3️⃣ Thinking Someone Else Will Do It
Many Christians believe, “That’s the pastor’s job.”
But Jesus gave the Great Commission to ALL believers, not just pastors!
📖 “Go into all the world and preach the Gospel to all creation.” (Mark 16:15)
💡 If you don’t share Jesus, who will?

🔥 What Happens If You Stay Silent?
🚨 People will die without Jesus.
Imagine your best friend or family member standing before God on Judgment Day.

They look at you and ask:
“You knew about Jesus… but never told me? Why?”
📖 “How can they believe in the one of whom they have not heard?” (Romans 10:14)
💡 Your silence could cost someone their eternity.

🔥 What Happens When You Share Jesus?
✅ People’s lives change.
✅ The lost find hope.
✅ You fulfill God’s calling.
📖 “Whoever acknowledges Me before others, I will also acknowledge before My Father in heaven.” (Matthew 10:32)
💡 Sharing Jesus brings joy, freedom, and eternal impact.

🔥 How to Boldly Share Jesus (Even If You’re Scared)
1️⃣ Start with Your Testimony

Share what Jesus has done in your life—that’s your most powerful tool!
📖 “They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony.” (Revelation 12:11)
2️⃣ Use Social Media for Christ

If you can post about movies, food, and opinions, you can post about Jesus!
📖 “Go and make disciples of all nations.” (Matthew 28:19)
3️⃣ Pray for Boldness

The early church prayed for boldness—and they changed the world.
📖 “They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.” (Acts 4:31)
4️⃣ Tell One Person About Jesus Today

Start with a friend, coworker, or family member.
📖 “Let your light shine before others.” (Matthew 5:16)
🚀 The more you share, the bolder you become!

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 18, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose to break my silence. I will boldly share my faith and point others to Jesus Christ. I will not let fear stop me from obeying God’s call to be a witness for Him."

🔥 THE “SHARE JESUS” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Share your testimony with one person today.
✅ Step 2: Post a Bible verse or Gospel message on social media.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends and encourage them to share their faith boldly.

🌌 YOU HAVE THE CURE – DON’T KEEP IT TO YOURSELF 🌌
📖 “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.” (Matthew 9:37)
👉 Don’t let fear hold you back. Your boldness could change someone’s eternity.

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 18, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Forgive me for the times I’ve stayed silent when I should have spoken up about You. Give me boldness to share my faith, to proclaim Jesus in every area of my life, and to stand firm in a world that rejects the truth. Fill me with Your Holy Spirit and use me to bring others into Your Kingdom.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
